newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-Focus on rollover ahead of expiry.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-Focus on rollover ahead of expiry.

text.p: Few big strategy deals were executed in the UK index and equity options markets on Tuesday as traders focused on rollover ahead of expiry.
December equity options expire on Wednesday and December index options and futures expire on Friday.
"It's deadly boring," said one derivatives specialist.
Among the few deals struck were the outright sale of 750 April 950 puts on Barclays Plc at 24-1/2p. The shares were down 4-1/2p to 994p at 1438 GMT.
Dealers noted the sale of 450 March 360 puts on Railtrack at 19p against the purchase of 450 March 360 calls at 22p, a so-called "synthetic."
They also noted a so-called "split synthetic" in Shell Transport options, where 400 April 950 puts were sold at 30p against the purchase of 400 April 1,000 calls at 33p, a slightly bullish trade.
Some 600 Thames Water January 600 calls were sold at at 5p, as the underlying shares climbed 10p to 578-1/2p.
